testcase.name: Tous les comptes ont un mot de passe
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SELECT user, host FROM mysql.user WHERE authentication_string = '' OR plugin='mysql_no_login';"
testcase.remediation: ALTER USER '<user>'@'<host>' IDENTIFIED BY '<password>'; ou utiliser mysql_secure_installation.
testcase.error:
Error: Impossible de se connecter à MySQL (serveur arrêté ou mauvais socket). Stdout:
Stderr: ERROR 2002 (HY000): Can't connect to local server through socket '/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock' (2) Return Code: 1

testcase.name: Expiration annuelle des mots de passe
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SELECT @@default_password_lifetime;"
testcase.remediation: SET PERSIST default_password_lifetime=365;
testcase.error:
Error: Impossible de se connecter à MySQL (serveur arrêté ou mauvais socket). Stdout:
Stderr: ERROR 2002 (HY000): Can't connect to local server through socket '/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock' (2) Return Code: 1

testcase.name: Politique de complexité forte
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'validate_password.policy';"
testcase.remediation: Installer et configurer component_validate_password avec une politique forte (ex: validate_password.policy=STRONG).
testcase.error:
Error: Impossible de se connecter à MySQL (serveur arrêté ou mauvais socket). Stdout:

testcase.name: Pas de wildcard '%' dans host
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SELECT user, host FROM mysql.user WHERE host = '%' AND user NOT IN ('root');"
testcase.remediation: ALTER USER '<user>'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '...' RENAME TO '<user>'@'<specific_host>'; ou supprimer le compte.
testcase.error:
Error: Impossible de se connecter à MySQL (serveur arrêté ou mauvais socket). Stdout:

testcase.name: Supprimer les comptes anonymes
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SELECT user, host FROM mysql.user WHERE user = '';"
testcase.remediation: DROP USER ''@'<host>'; ou utiliser mysql_secure_installation.
testcase.error:
Error: Impossible de se connecter à MySQL (serveur arrêté ou mauvais socket). Stdout:

testcase.name: Forcer SSL/TLS (require_secure_transport=ON)
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SELECT @@require_secure_transport;"
testcase.remediation: Configurer les certificats SSL/TLS, puis ajouter require_secure_transport=ON dans my.cnf.
testcase.error:
Error: Impossible de se connecter à MySQL (serveur arrêté ou mauvais socket). Stdout:

testcase.name: Exiger TLS côté utilisateur (ssl_type)
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SELECT count(*) FROM mysql.user WHERE host NOT IN ('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1') AND ssl_type = '';"
testcase.remediation: ALTER USER '<user>'@'<host>' REQUIRE SSL; ou REQUIRE X509;

testcase.name: Limiter le nombre de connexions
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SELECT @@max_connections;"
testcase.remediation: Ajuster max_connections et max_user_connections dans my.cnf selon les besoins.

testcase.name: Chiffrer le trafic de réplication
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SHOW REPLICA STATUS\G" | grep -E 'SSL_Allowed|Master_SSL_Verify_Server_Cert'
testcase.remediation: Configurer TLS pour la réplication (SOURCE_SSL=1, SOURCE_SSL_CA, etc.) ou utiliser un tunnel sécurisé.

testcase.name: SOURCE_SSL_VERIFY_SERVER_CERT = 1
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SHOW REPLICA STATUS\G" | grep 'Master_SSL_Verify_Server_Cert'
testcase.remediation: Exécuter CHANGE REPLICATION SOURCE TO SOURCE_SSL_VERIFY_SERVER_CERT = 1;

testcase.name: master_info_repository TABLE
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SELECT @@master_info_repository;"
testcase.remediation: Configurer master_info_repository=TABLE dans my.cnf.

testcase.name: Retirer SUPER aux comptes de réplication
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SELECT count(*) FROM mysql.user WHERE user LIKE '%repl%' AND Super_priv = 'Y';"
testcase.remediation: REVOKE SUPER ON *.* FROM '<repl_user>'@'<repl_host>'; et accorder les privilèges dynamiques nécessaires (ex: REPLICATION_SLAVE_ADMIN).

testcase.name: Chiffrer le trafic Group Replication
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SELECT @@group_replication_ssl_mode;"
testcase.remediation: Configurer group_replication_ssl_mode à REQUIRED, VERIFY_CA, ou VERIFY_IDENTITY dans my.cnf.

testcase.name: Définir une allow-list de nœuds
testcase.system-out: Test Command: mysql -N -B -e "SELECT @@group_replication_ip_allowlist;"
testcase.remediation: Configurer group_replication_ip_allowlist avec les adresses IP/CIDR des nœuds autorisés.
